name: ERAU Speedcubing Fall 2019

venue.name: ERAU Henderson Welcome Center
venue.details: The venue is a large ballroom directly off the atrium of the welcome center on the first floor, to the left as you enter

information: The main event of this competition is 3 x 3. If we should get ahead in the schedule we will add a final of 4x4 with 12 competitors advancing by ranking and a final of 5x5 with 12 competitors advancing by ranking.
